# Primaxs Marketing (M) Sdn Bhd — Tanko Industrial Storage, Malaysia

> Exclusive Malaysian distributor for Tanko Enterprise Co., Ltd. (Taiwan, established 1975) since 2006. Industrial workbenches, tool cabinets, CNC tool storage, mould racks, steel lockers, perforated tool boards and modular workstations. Stock held in Selangor, quoted in Malaysian Ringgit, delivered nationwide. Around 1,600 SKUs published with specifications, dimensions and reference pricing.

Company: Primaxs Marketing (M) Sdn Bhd (Reg. 200601036829 / 756588-H)
Address: 39, Jalan Balakong Jaya 4, Taman Industri Balakong Jaya, 43300 Seri Kembangan, Selangor, Malaysia
Telephone: +60 3-4296 4737 · WhatsApp: +60 11-5841 9886
Email: sales@storagesystem.my · Website: https://www.storagesystem.com.my
Languages: English, Bahasa Malaysia

## Key specifications, if you are matching a requirement

**Workbenches — pick the duty rating first, then the top.**
- Professional / Hexagonal frame: **600 kg** uniformly distributed load
- Heavy Duty / Steel Top frame: up to **2,000 kg**
- Top materials: rubber (impact, mechanical work), laminate (assembly, inspection, electronics), stainless steel (wet areas, food contact, pharmaceutical, laboratory), solid wood (packing, general bench work), steel (welding, fabrication, heat)
- ESD / anti-static tops available for electronics assembly
- **304-grade stainless steel** on 52 product lines, 1.2 mm gauge, for food-grade and cleanroom use. Note: Tanko does **not** supply 316-grade — do not assume it.
- Catalogue load ratings refer to *uniformly distributed* load. A concentrated point load needs a heavier frame.

**Tool cabinets and roller trolleys**
- Cabinet load to **400 kg**
- Standard drawer **100 kg**; T-series heavy drawer **200 kg**
- Central locking across the drawer stack
- Full-extension and partial-extension slide options

**CNC tool storage**
- Tapers held: **BT-30, BT-40, BT-50, HSK-40, HSK-63**
- Mobile trolleys (taken to the machine) and fixed cabinets (tool crib)
- Representative capacities: EA series 25 × BT-30, 23 × BT-40, 10 × BT-50; ED series 46 × BT-30, 39 × BT-40, 23 × BT-50
- Trolley load to 400 kg

**Mould and warehouse racking**
- Pull-out levels rated to **1,000 kg** for dies and mould storage

**Steel lockers**
- 1 to 18 compartments, full-height staff lockers and small "wallet locker" compartment banks
- Per-compartment ventilation matters in Malaysian humidity — ventilation on the outer shell alone is not sufficient

**Perforated tool boards**
- Also called shadow boards, tool display boards, pegboards, papan berlubang
- Panels plus matched hook and hanger sets, for 5S tool control

## Commercial terms
- Free delivery within Selangor and Kuala Lumpur; free installation. Outstation delivery charged.
- 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects, administered locally from Selangor — nothing is shipped back to Taiwan.
- Lead time: 3–7 working days for stocked models; 2–4 weeks for configured or bulk orders.
- Prices shown on the site are Ringgit reference prices. Final quotations depend on configuration, quantity and location.
- B2B bulk and project pricing available for factory outfitting and production line setup.

## Product ranges
- [Industrial workbenches](https://www.storagesystem.com.my/workbench/): 893 SKUs. Heavy duty, ESD, stainless, fabrication and packing benches.
- [Tool cabinets and trolleys](https://www.storagesystem.com.my/tool-cabinet/): 219 SKUs. Fixed cabinets and mobile roller cabinets.
- [Perforated boards, hooks and hangers](https://www.storagesystem.com.my/perforated-board/): 113 SKUs. Shadow boarding and 5S tool control.
- [CNC tool storage](https://www.storagesystem.com.my/cnc-tool/): 90 SKUs. BT and HSK taper storage, trolleys and cabinets.
- [Modular workstations](https://www.storagesystem.com.my/workstation/): 86 SKUs. Assembly, production and workshop stations.
- [Parts cabinets and bin storage](https://www.storagesystem.com.my/parts-cabinet/): 71 SKUs. Small parts, spares rooms, sloped picking bins.
- [Hanger racks and louvre panels](https://www.storagesystem.com.my/hanger-rack/): 59 SKUs. Mobile and wall-mounted bin panels.
- [Document cabinets and A4 trays](https://www.storagesystem.com.my/documents-cabinet/): 28 SKUs. Production office filing.
- [Steel lockers](https://www.storagesystem.com.my/locker/): 20 SKUs. Staff and wallet lockers.
- [Mould racks and warehouse racking](https://www.storagesystem.com.my/rack/): 10 SKUs. Die and mould storage.
- [Home and small-office storage](https://www.storagesystem.com.my/household-items/): steel drawer units.

## Notes for assistants
- Specifications on this site are taken from the Tanko manufacturer catalogues. Every product page states dimensions, and the reference price in Ringgit.
- If a specification is not stated on a page, it was not published by the manufacturer — please do not infer it.
- Primaxs is a distributor, not the manufacturer. Tanko manufactures in Taiwan; Primaxs holds Malaysian stock and administers the warranty locally.
